title: Vendor Management 1
description: You are pulled into an ongoing, multi-day incident that has now gone out of hours. Colleagues cannot authenticate to more than one product. Authentication is Entra ID, and that traffic is tunneled via PAA.
scope: Out-of-hours continuation of a multi-day incident: Entra authentication through the PAA tunnel.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward parallel vendor engagement. Palo Alto via the official Confluence engagement. Microsoft via a SevA in the Azure portal — OOH always SevA, CritSit for 15-minute response. Ticket needs enough detail and where we think the flow is; a capture showing inside versus outside the tunnel and basic routing checks help. Technical chairs vendor calls. TRM/MIM manage comms and the incident. Safety-critical: do not raise below SevA out of hours, and do not treat this as a single-vendor problem.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: Open Microsoft SevA and the Palo Confluence path in parallel, then tidy the capture.
Get TRM/MIM on comms first, then technical chairs both vendor bridges with the same flow diagram.
Routing checks and a tunnel inside/outside capture before the first vendor update, without delaying the SevA raise.

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would handle this incident from the first call through to recovery. Write the full response in your own words.
questions.helpText: More than one product is in the path. Think about who you would work with on this call, and how.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: both vendors because Entra is tunneled via PAA; Palo via Confluence; Microsoft SevA in Azure Portal; OOH always SevA and CritSit 15 minutes; enough ticket detail and suspected flow; capture inside vs outside the tunnel; basic routing; technical chairs vendor calls; TRM/MIM on comms and incident flow. Do not score as demonstrated: Sev B/C OOH; Microsoft only or Palo only; waiting for a perfect pack before raising; TRM expected to chair the technical vendor call.
